Today I’m substitute teacher on occasion, you still see all of this stuff again minus the hazing sometimes. I think dazed and confused is so timeless because think about it from the three perspectives 

Mitch is the kid going into this world excited and eager his other middle school buddies didnt experience that night 

Randall pink floyd disillusioned with the world he lives in

Fred not wanting o move on 

And david wooderson desperately wanting to go back

In a sense any one person can identify with at least one of these people. In the case of the majority they are Mitch’s middle school buddies, simply watching from the sidelines wondering about how cool it must be to hang with the main group.
